description: Canonical metric dictionary. Bump the version and add a new file for breaking changes; never edit a released version's meaning in place.

views.description: Number of times the content was shown/played (platform-defined).

reach.description: Unique accounts that saw the content (usually an estimate).

avg_watch_time_seconds.description: Average time spent watching per view.

total_watch_time_seconds.description: Total time spent watching across all views.

followers.description: Follower/subscriber count of the account at collection time.

profile_visits.description: Visits to the account profile in the period.

mappings.notes: Media insights metric 'views' (replaced 'plays'/'impressions' in 2025). Counts repeat views; not comparable 1:1 with YouTube views.
